title: Signal Fire
authorship: Original composition authored for this project; no source melody or MIDI sequence copied
brief: An original festival-house cue in A minor at 128 BPM that exercises synths, drum machine, ducking, sweeps and a loud master.

sections.intent: drums and a filtered arpeggio open up
pads and the theme, no kick
snare roll, riser, rising high-pass, a beat of silence
drums and bass, the pads fade
